title: Forest's Fluttering

outfit_card.silhouette: A-line layered explorer coat-dress with a pinched waist corset, flared midi skirt, voluminous puffed sleeves, and an asymmetrical diagonal chest strap.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A structured cream newsboy cap adorned with round daisy-motif goggles, a gold-trimmed brim, and a delicate ribbon tassel hanging at the side.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Cream safari-style bodice with gold piping, a high collar, and a diagonal leather strap, overlaid with an emerald-green gathered corset featuring a large, translucent butterfly-wing motif and puffed half-sleeves with dark piping.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A tiered cream midi skirt with utility pockets and gold button accents, paired with dark knee-high socks and sturdy forest-green lace-up hiking boots.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A transparent glass jar with a gold lid and a glowing butterfly inside, worn with a leather crossbody strap, alongside translucent butterfly accents and scattered daisy motifs.
